Website services for law firms

Fast, secure websites for law firms, built and looked after for you

Want the advice in these guides done for you? I design, build, move and maintain WordPress websites for solo attorneys and small firms, so you can focus on clients instead of plugins and DNS records.

Book a free consultationSee services

Every project includes

  • You own everythingDomain, hosting and site accounts in your firm's name.
  • Security from day oneSSL, backups, two-factor login and a firewall.
  • Intake-readyClear calls to action and contact forms tested before launch.
  • Plain-English updatesNo jargon, no surprises, a fixed written quote.
Services

Everything your firm's website needs

Choose a single service or combine them. Every project starts with a free consultation and a fixed written quote.

New law firm website

A WordPress site planned around your practice areas, intake process and local search.

  • Practice-area and attorney pages
  • Mobile-first, fast-loading design
  • Contact and consultation forms
  • On-page SEO foundations
Discuss a new site →

Website redesign

Rebuild an outdated or slow site while protecting the rankings you already have.

  • Content and URL audit
  • 301 redirects for changed pages
  • Modern, accessible design
  • Speed and security upgrades
Discuss a redesign →

Hosting migration

Move to better hosting with a tested plan, without downtime or lost email.

  • Full backup before the move
  • Testing on the new host first
  • DNS, SSL and email checks
  • Post-move monitoring
Discuss a migration →

Domain and email setup

Professional email on your own domain, configured correctly from the start.

  • Google Workspace or Microsoft 365
  • MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC
  • Mailbox and alias setup
  • Two-factor authentication
Discuss email setup →

Security hardening

Lock down an existing WordPress site and protect client inquiries.

  • Security audit and clean-up
  • Firewall and malware scanning
  • Secure contact forms
  • Backup and incident plan
Discuss security →

Care and maintenance

Ongoing updates, backups, monitoring and small content changes.

  • Core, theme and plugin updates
  • Off-site backups and restore tests
  • Uptime and security monitoring
  • Form testing and content edits
Discuss a care plan →
Who it's for

Built for small firms without an IT department

Most of my clients are solo attorneys and small firms that need a professional website and reliable email, but don't have the time or staff to manage the technology.

  • You're launching a new firm or replacing a DIY website
  • Your current site is slow, outdated or hard to update
  • You want to move hosts or set up professional email safely
  • You want someone dependable to keep the site updated and secure

Tools and platforms I work with

WordPressElementorGutenbergKinstaSiteGroundHostingerCloudflareGoogle WorkspaceMicrosoft 365Rank MathWPFormsGravity Forms

Not sure which tools you need? That's what the consultation is for. You can also read our tool comparisons.

About me

Hi, I'm Jayce

Jayce Tuazon CabangcalaWordPress developer, webmaster, SEO and web designer. Working remotely with clients worldwide.
8+years building websites
1,000+websites delivered
8page builders supported
6regions served: US, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, Asia

How it works

A clear process from first call to launch

Free consultation

A short call about your firm, your current site and your goals.

Written proposal

A clear scope, timeline and fixed quote, so there are no surprises.

Build and review

You review everything on a private staging site before it goes live.

Launch

DNS, SSL, redirects, forms and email are checked carefully during the switch.

Ongoing care

Optional maintenance keeps the site updated, backed up and monitored.

Questions

Before we work together

How much does a law firm website cost?

It depends on the number of pages, features and how much content you already have. Every project gets a fixed written quote after the consultation. For typical cost ranges, see how much a law firm website costs in 2026.

Will I own my website and domain?

Yes. Your domain, hosting and website accounts are registered in your firm's name, and you keep full access.

Can you work on a website I already have?

Yes. Redesigns, migrations, security clean-ups and maintenance of existing WordPress sites are all welcome.

Do you work with firms in other states?

Yes. Projects are handled remotely by email and video call.

Do you write the website content?

You know your practice best, so most firms provide the core information. I help structure pages, edit for clarity and make sure each page has a clear call to action.

What happens after launch?

You can maintain the site yourself with a short handover, or choose an ongoing care plan for updates, backups and monitoring.

Let's talk about your firm's website

Tell me a little about your firm and what you need. I'll reply with next steps.

Book a free consultation
